cleanup: 1 blob gaussian removed (0.0004%), 0.53 in scale against an object diagonal of 0.91. Recentred on its own bounding box (a 2.8% shift).
caveats: The hardest subject in the set. A mirrored glass prism reflects the sky on every face, so the generator gets no shading cue for the cross-section: eight of the twelve attempts came out as a billboard, slender seen edge-on and a wide wedge seen face-on.

Regenerated 2026-08-03. What fixed it was cropping the cluttered base out of the input so the tower is cut cleanly, plus a different sampling seed; the cross-section is now square to within 6%, against 21% before. The whole object is kept, where the first version had to be cropped to a cylinder and shipped 106k of 262k gaussians.
